study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Kim et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping cerebellar anatomical heterogeneity in mental and neurological illnesses

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study combined data from 132 scanning sites including ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, UK Biobank, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, PNC, and TOP. This represents a large multi-site dataset for normative modeling of cerebellar anatomy.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The cohort of individuals without diagnoses was obtained from 132 scanning sites, including various studies such as ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, and UK Biobank." ... "As for the clinical datasets, we combined data from ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP"
